questions.scenario: The enzyme catalase breaks down hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen. Learners added potato extract (which contains catalase) to hydrogen peroxide at different pH values and collected the oxygen for 2 minutes.
questions.scenarioAf: Die ensiem katalase breek waterstofperoksied af in water en suurstof. Leerders het aartappelekstrak (wat katalase bevat) by waterstofperoksied by verskillende pH-waardes gevoeg en die suurstof vir 2 minute opgevang.

questions.q: Identify the independent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike veranderlike.
points: pH

questions.q: Identify the dependent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die afhanklike veranderlike.
points: the volume of oxygen collected in 2 minutes
pointsAf: die volume suurstof wat in 2 minute opgevang is

questions.q: Write down the optimum pH for catalase.
questions.qAf: Skryf die optimum pH vir katalase neer.

questions.q: Explain why very little oxygen was produced at pH 11.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom baie min suurstof by pH 11 geproduseer is.
points: The enzyme was (partly) denatured

pointsAf: die vorm van die aktiewe setel het verander, dus kon minder substraatmolekules inpas

questions.q: Name TWO variables that had to be kept constant.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE veranderlikes wat konstant gehou moes word.
points: the temperature

pointsAf: die volume en konsentrasie van waterstofperoksied, of die hoeveelheid aartappelekstrak

questions.scenario: Cubes of pink agar of different sizes were placed in dilute acid. The acid diffused into the cubes and turned the agar colourless. The time taken for the whole cube to turn colourless was recorded.
questions.scenarioAf: Kubusse pienk agar van verskillende groottes is in verdunde suur geplaas. Die suur het in die kubusse ingediffundeer en die agar kleurloos gemaak. Die tyd wat dit geneem het vir die hele kubus om kleurloos te word, is aangeteken.

questions.q: Define diffusion.

pointsAf: Die beweging van molekules van ’n gebied met ’n hoë konsentrasie

questions.q: State the aim of the investigation.
questions.qAf: Noem die doel van die ondersoek.

pointsAf: Om die invloed van grootte (oppervlakte-tot-volume-verhouding) op die tempo van diffusie te ondersoek

questions.q: Identify the dependent variable.

questions.q: Calculate the surface area to volume ratio of the 2 cm cube.
questions.qAf: Bereken die oppervlakte-tot-volume-verhouding van die kubus van 2 cm.
points: surface area = 6 × 4 = 24 cm² and volume = 8 cm³
ratio = 3 : 1

questions.scenario:
The descriptions below are of four cells, each in a different phase of mitosis.
Cell W: chromatids move apart towards the poles of the cell.
Cell X: two new nuclei form and the cell membrane begins to pinch in.
Cell Y: chromosomes become visible as the nuclear membrane breaks down and spindle fibres form.
Cell Z: chromosomes are arranged in a single line across the middle of the cell.
questions.scenarioAf:
Die beskrywings hieronder is van vier selle, elk in ’n ander fase van mitose.
Sel W: chromatiede beweeg uitmekaar na die pole van die sel.
Sel X: twee nuwe kerne vorm en die selmembraan begin inknyp.
Sel Y: chromosome word sigbaar terwyl die kernmembraan afbreek en spoelvesels vorm.
Sel Z: chromosome is in ’n enkele lyn oor die middel van die sel gerangskik.

questions.q: Name the phase of mitosis for each cell.
questions.qAf: Noem die fase van mitose vir elke sel.
points: W: anaphase
X: telophase
Y: prophase
Z: metaphase

questions.q: Write the letters of the cells in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Skryf die letters van die selle in die korrekte volgorde.
points: Y ; Z ; W ; X

questions.q: Name the stage of the cell cycle when the cell is not dividing.
questions.qAf: Noem die stadium van die selsiklus wanneer die sel nie verdeel nie.
points: interphase

questions.q: Describe the structure of a chromosome just before mitosis.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die struktuur van ’n chromosoom net voor mitose.
points: It consists of two identical chromatids
joined at a centromere
pointsAf: Dit bestaan uit twee identiese chromatiede

questions.q: Explain why the two daughter cells formed by mitosis are genetically identical.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die twee dogterselle wat deur mitose gevorm word, geneties identies is.
points: The DNA is copied exactly during interphase
and each daughter cell receives one chromatid of every chromosome
pointsAf: Die DNS word tydens interfase presies gekopieer
en elke dogtersel ontvang een chromatied van elke chromosoom

questions.q: Explain how a tumour forms.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n gewas vorm.
points: Cells divide by mitosis in an uncontrolled way
forming a mass of cells (a tumour)
pointsAf: Selle verdeel op ’n onbeheerde manier deur mitose

questions.q: State ONE difference between skeletal muscle and smooth muscle.

questions.scenario: Three identical potted plants were weighed before and after 5 hours under different conditions. Each pot was covered with a plastic bag tied around the stem.
questions.scenarioAf: Drie identiese potplante is voor en ná 5 uur onder verskillende toestande geweeg. Elke pot is met ’n plastieksak bedek wat om die stingel vasgebind is.

questions.q: Why was each pot covered with a plastic bag?
questions.qAf: Waarom is elke pot met ’n plastieksak bedek?
points: So that water could only be lost from the plant, not from the soil
pointsAf: Sodat water slegs uit die plant, en nie uit die grond nie, verlore kon gaan

questions.q: Calculate the rate of water loss in the light, in grams per hour.
questions.qAf: Bereken die tempo van waterverlies in die lig, in gram per uur.
points: = 4 g per hour

questions.q: Explain why the plant lost more water in the light than in the dark.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die plant meer water in die lig as in die donker verloor het.
points: In the light the stomata are open
so water vapour can diffuse out of the leaves
in the dark most stomata are closed
pointsAf: In die lig is die huidmondjies oop
dus kan waterdamp uit die blare diffundeer
in die donker is die meeste huidmondjies toe

questions.q: Explain the result for the plant with petroleum jelly on its leaves.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die resultaat vir die plant met petroleumjellie op sy blare.
points: Most stomata are on the lower surfaces of the leaves
the jelly blocked them, so very little water could escape
pointsAf: Die meeste huidmondjies is op die onderste oppervlakke van die blare
die jellie het hulle geblokkeer, dus kon baie min water ontsnap

questions.q: Give TWO adaptations of desert plants that reduce water loss.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE aanpassings van woestynplante wat waterverlies verminder.
points: a thick waxy cuticle, or small leaves (spines)
sunken stomata, or fewer stomata
pointsAf: ’n dik wasagtige kutikula, of klein blare (dorings)

questions.q: Name the process by which water enters the root hairs.
questions.qAf: Noem die proses waardeur water die wortelhare binnegaan.
points: osmosis

questions.q: Name the tissue that transports sugars in the plant.
questions.qAf: Noem die weefsel wat suikers in die plant vervoer.
points: phloem

questions.q: Name TWO environmental factors, other than light, that affect the rate of transpiration.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE omgewingsfaktore, buiten lig, wat die tempo van transpirasie beïnvloed.
points: temperature
humidity, or wind

questions.q:
Describe how the tissues of a leaf are arranged and suited to their functions, and explain how stomata open and close.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf hoe die weefsels van ’n blaar gerangskik en by hul funksies aangepas is, en verduidelik hoe huidmondjies oop- en toegaan.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: The upper epidermis is a single layer of transparent cells that lets light through
It is covered by a waxy cuticle that reduces water loss
Palisade mesophyll cells are long, closely packed cells
with many chloroplasts, so they are the main site of photosynthesis
Spongy mesophyll cells are loosely packed with large air spaces
which allow gases to diffuse through the leaf
The veins (vascular bundles) contain xylem, which brings water and minerals to the leaf
and phloem, which carries sugars away from the leaf
The lower epidermis has many stomata
Each stoma is surrounded by two guard cells
Guard cells contain chloroplasts
and their inner walls are thicker than their outer walls
In the light, guard cells take in potassium ions and make sugar, so their solute concentration rises
water enters the guard cells by osmosis
the guard cells become turgid
the thin outer walls stretch more, so the cells curve apart and the stoma opens
In the dark or when water is short, the guard cells lose water
they become flaccid and the stoma closes
pointsAf: Die boonste epidermis is ’n enkele laag deursigtige selle wat lig deurlaat
Dit is bedek met ’n wasagtige kutikula wat waterverlies verminder
Palissademesofilselle is lang, dig gepakte selle
met baie chloroplaste, dus is hulle die hoofplek van fotosintese
Sponsmesofilselle is los gepak met groot lugruimtes
wat gasse deur die blaar laat diffundeer
Die are (vaatbondels) bevat xileem, wat water en minerale na die blaar bring
en floëem, wat suikers weg van die blaar vervoer
Die onderste epidermis het baie huidmondjies
Elke huidmondjie word deur twee sluitselle omring
en hul binneste wande is dikker as hul buitenste wande
In die lig neem sluitselle kaliumione op en maak suiker, dus styg hul konsentrasie opgeloste stowwe
water gaan die sluitselle deur osmose binne
die dun buitenste wande rek meer, dus buig die selle uitmekaar en die huidmondjie gaan oop
In die donker of wanneer water skaars is, verloor die sluitselle water
hulle word slap en die huidmondjie gaan toe

questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about leaf tissues and stomata; nothing irrelevant
Logical sequence (1): the tissues are described in order from the upper to the lower surface
Comprehensive (1): at least 6/8 for leaf tissues and 6/10 for stomata
pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor blaarweefsels en huidmondjies; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): die weefsels word in volgorde van die boonste tot die onderste oppervlak beskryf
Omvattend (1): ten minste 6/8 vir blaarweefsels en 6/10 vir huidmondjies
